meaning:
1) leg, thigh
1a) of man; specifically the lower leg (calf) as opposed to the thigh
1b) of sacrificial animal; specifically the thigh, upper leg, hind leg, as the portion eaten
Aramaic equivalent: shaq (שָׁק "leg" H8243)

elsewhere.note: Also you shall take some of the ram’s fat, the fat tail, the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, the fat that is on them, and…
The right thigh you shall give to the priest for a heave offering out of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh. They are holy for the priest, together with the breast that is waved and the thigh that is…
Yahweh will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil, of which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.
He struck them hip and thigh with a great slaughter; and he went down and lived in the cave in Etam’s rock.
The cook took up the thigh, and that which was on it, and set it before Saul. Samuel said, “Behold, that which has been reserved! Set it before yourself and…
He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
Like the legs of the lame that hang loose, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
